  "overall_experience": "This People Excellence Manager likely found Notion to be a highly versatile platform for centralizing internal knowledge and managing various HR-related projects. While its flexibility was a major advantage for their role, the initial learning curve and the effort required for setup, especially when transitioning from a more structured tool like monday.com, might have presented early challenges.
